mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP (demand) growth signals expanding economic activity, which boosts equity valuations and compresses discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in <50% of instances during GDP growth periods (t-test p >0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 2.5% triggers a tightening monetary policy cycle, raising discount rates on equity cash flows and resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns remain negative in <30% of triggered instances (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in both GDP (demand) and HOUST (demand) indicators signals robust demand growth, which expands corporate earnings and equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05) when both proxies rise simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in unemployment claims (UNRATE) below 3% in a late-cycle expansion regime predicts weakening labor market pressures, reducing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns not significantly positive (p>0.05) when UNRATE <3% in late-cycle expansion.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in GDP (demand) and decline in INDPRO (supply) reflects an imbalanced demand-supply cycle favoring demand, which drives up equity valuations and compresses discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns not significantly positive (p>0.05) when GDPC1 rises and INDPRO falls.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained inflation surge above 2% in a rising inflation cycle triggers central bank tightening, raising discount rates on equity cash flows and resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns remain non-negative in >70% of triggered instances (p<0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in RSAFS (demand) below previous month's level in a post-shock recovery regime signals improving labor market conditions, reducing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS < previous and regime: post-shock recovery
failure_condition: 60d returns not significantly positive (p>0.05) when RSAFS falls in post-shock recovery.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in INDPRO (supply) and FEDFUNDS (monetary) below their 5-week averages indicates easing supply constraints and accommodative monetary policy, fostering growth and compressing discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns not significantly positive (p>0.05) when both proxies are below thresholds.
